description: Generate and inspect UUIDs. Operations: "v4" — Generate one or more random (v4) UUIDs.; "v3" — Generate a name-based (v3 / MD5) UUID.; "parse" — Parse a UUID and report its version, variant and (where present) timestamp.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: v4 returns a different result on each call.

input.description: v4: Unused (pass an empty string). v3: The name to hash. parse: The UUID to parse.

operation.description: v4 — Generate one or more random (v4) UUIDs. v3 — Generate a name-based (v3 / MD5) UUID. parse — Parse a UUID and report its version, variant and (where present) timestamp.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

count.description: How many UUIDs to generate. Used by: v4.

name: uuid
title: UUID Generator
